theorem lg_target : (Finset.filter (fun n => n % 3 = 0) (Finset.range 30)).card = 10 := by
  have h : (Finset.range 30).card = 30 := Finset.card_range 30
  simp only [h, Finset.card_filter, Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range, Nat.count_mod_eq_div]
  rw [Nat.div_eq_floor, Nat.floor_eq_of_le, Nat.lt_iff_le_not_le, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt, Nat.le_of_lt]
  exact Nat.div_eq (30 / 3) 10
